page0.text:
Well, I don't want to complain about this training...
...but I also think that if there is some sort of secret move I could learn that might let me get through this training, I might be more enthusiastic about sparring against Saber.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-06:page0:1

page1.text:
"Saber. Hear me out."
"Yes, what is it, Shirou? You certainly look expectant."
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-06:page1:1

page2.text: "You think so? Hm, well I guess I want to ask you for a favor, and I have some high hopes for it... But let me get to the point: there's something I want you to teach me."
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-06:page2:1

page3.text: "Huh. I am not entirely sure what exactly you wish to learn, but I will share what I can with you."
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-06:page3:1

page4.text: Saber thinks it's a serious conversation, so she sits in front of me in a formal seiza position.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-06:page4:1

page5.text:
"So what is it that you want to know? Is it about Servants?"
Saber regards me seriously.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-06:page5:1

page6.text:
"...Uh."
I feel like I already know what's going to happen in the next few seconds here, but I should go for broke and ask anyway.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-06:page6:1

page7.text: "Um...I'm actually really serious about this, so I want you to hear me out and please not get mad."
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-06:page7:1

page8.text: "Yes, that is why I mean to listen intently. Please do not hold back. Ask whatever is on your mind."
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-06:page8:1

page9.text:
"Okay, I'm going to take you at your word...
So...is there some sort of secret technique I could learn that would let me take down a Servant? It'd be great if it were strong enough to take even you down."
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-06:page9:1

page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-06:page10:1

page11.text:
...
Saber's brow doesn't move so much as a millimeter.
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-06:page11:1

page12.text:
"I-I knew it couldn't be that easy, right?
Sorry...I apologize... It was my bad! I was only joking, so I would really appreciate if you just understood I was kidding and pretended you didn't hear any of that!"
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-06:page12:1

page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-06:page13:1

page14.text: "S-Saber? I might be imagining things, but you seem to have an evil smile on your face that...doesn't quite fit you..."
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-06:page14:1

page15.text: "Oh it is not your imagination. I am feeling every bit as wicked as Rin right now."
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-06:page15:1

page16.text:
"Aaaah!!!"
Every hair on my body stands on end.
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-06:page16:1

page17.text:
"Uh...ah...uh..."
"Why are you so distressed, Shirou? I have not yet answered your question. If I recall correctly, you desire a secret attack powerful enough to defeat a Servant in a single blow, yes?"
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-06:page17:1

page18.text: I retreat instinctively, but Saber closes the distance between us, not allowing me to escape.
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-06:page18:1

page19.text:
"I...uh, well, you see... Saber, are you mad?"
"Oh, very."
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-06:page19:1

page20.text:
I am a dead man.
If Saber and I were actually to fight right now, I'd die.
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-06:page20:1

page21.text:
"...Hold it. Let's calm down, Saber.
I regret what I said. I have a pretty good idea why you're mad too."
"Do you, now? Then please, seat yourself there, seiza style. My rage will not abate until I have properly explained everything to you."
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-06:page21:1

page22.text:
Saber gets to her feet.
I quickly sit up straight, just as Saber had been, and brace myself for the worst.
page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-06:page22:1

page23.text:
...
Saber takes a deep breath.
And...
page23.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-06:page23:1

page24.text: "HOW CAN YOU BE SO RIDICULOUS!? WHAT WERE YOU THINKING, ASKING ME TO TEACH YOU SUCH A TECHNIQUE!?"
page24.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-06:page24:1

page25.text:
"Agh... Oof."
The sheer volume is wreaking havoc on my poor ears.
I had no idea her yelling alone could paralyze me.
No human could ever shout so loud.
It's like the roar of a beast...a lion.
page25.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-06:page25:1

page26.text:
"S-sorry... I said I regret my actions.
Saber, you're stronger than me. I just thought maybe you knew some kind of sword skill even amateurs could learn."
page26.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-06:page26:1

page27.text:
"No such easy path exists!
An ambush is best used against an opponent with whom you are evenly matched, and amateurs like you must carefully build a foundation before even considering using such a thing!"
page27.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-06:page27:1

page28.text: "Besides, I have already told you not to think about defeating your opponent! Defending yourself is your first priority! If there is to be a special secret move for you, Shirou, it would be gaining the ability to lead a battle without actually fighting!"
page28.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-06:page28:1

page29.text:
"Ugh...I know. I got it...so can you tone it down a bit?"
I show her how bad I feel about this, and clap my hands together like I'm praying for her forgiveness.
page29.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-06:page29:1

page30.text:
"Honestly... I thought you had some potential, but then, a moment later, THIS is what you ask me. If you continue like this, it will simply be too dangerous to leave you alone!"
Saber continues scolding me.
page30.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-06:page30:1

page31.text:
"...Hnn..."
I stepped on the lion's tail and incurred her wrath.
I'll just keep my mouth shut and endure Saber's scolding.
page31.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-06:page31:1
